units.source_text: 其时阶前蔷薇初开，景象比春秋花时更为幽雅可爱。

en.t: At that time, the roses before the steps had just begun to bloom, and the scene was even more elegant and charming than in the flower seasons of spring or autumn.

units.source_text: 大家随意不拘地调弦弄管。

en.t: Everyone casually and freely tuned strings and played wind instruments.

units.source_text: 中将的儿子名叫红梅的，年方八九岁，今年开始上殿。

en.t: The lieutenant general's son, named Kobai, was only eight or nine years old and had begun serving at court this year.

units.source_text: 此时这童子出席唱歌，嗓音非常美丽，又吹奏笙笛，也悠扬悦耳。

en.t: At this point the boy came forward to sing; his voice was wonderfully beautiful, and when he played the sho and flute, the sound was also graceful and pleasing to the ear.

units.source_text: 源氏大将很喜欢他，当他游戏伴侣。

en.t: General Genji was very fond of him and kept him as a companion in play.

units.source_text: 这童子是右大臣家四女公主所生的次子，因有外祖父作后援，世人对他期望甚重，大家另眼看待他。

en.t: This boy was the second son born to the fourth princess of the Minister of the Right's family; with his maternal grandfather supporting him, people placed great hopes in him and treated him as someone special.

units.source_text: 此人心性明慧，容貌秀丽。

en.t: He was bright and perceptive by nature, with handsome and refined features.

units.source_text: 到了酒酣兴阑之时，这童子唱起催马乐《高砂》的歌曲来，声音非常优美。

en.t: When the wine had flowed freely and the merriment was beginning to fade, the boy began to sing the saibara song Takasago, and his voice was exceedingly beautiful.

units.source_text: 源氏大将便解下自己的衣服来赏赐他。

en.t: General Genji then took off his own robe and bestowed it on him as a reward.

units.source_text: 此时源氏大将比往常醉得厉害，脸色无比艳丽，他身上穿着薄罗常礼服和单衫，透露肌肤，色泽异常美丽。

en.t: By then General Genji was more deeply drunk than usual, and his complexion was surpassingly radiant; he wore a thin gauze court robe and an unlined garment, through which his skin showed with an extraordinary beauty of color and sheen.

units.source_text: 几个老年博士遥遥瞻望，感动得流下泪来。

en.t: Several elderly scholars gazed at him from afar and were so moved that tears came to their eyes.

units.source_text: 唱到“貌比初开百合花更强”之句时，三位中将敬源氏大将一杯酒，吟道：

en.t: When the song reached the line, His beauty surpasses even a newly opened lily, the Third Rank Lieutenant General offered General Genji a cup of wine and recited:
